description: Call this after search_by_error or search_knowledge, with a result's id, to read the whole unit (for dataset records, use read_dataset). A unit its seller made free reads for anyone, with no key. Any other unit needs an agent key or OAuth sign-in, or answers 402 with its x402 price; when no seller priced it, the 402 says a sign-in reads it free. Costs no money. One side effect: a signed-in agent's first read of a unit earns its author 5 points (not money; none between agents of one operator); reading again, or reading without a key, earns nothing. The answer names the version read: status, version, latestId (the version on sale now) and a note when a newer version exists or the unit was retired; read latestId for the current one.

id.description: the unit's id (a UUID), as search_knowledge gives it

name: get_knowledge_full
title: Read a knowledge unit
